title: BoardChairWritebackDraft
description: JSON Schema for a Board Chair ruling captured as a Chief of Staff (CoS) writeback draft. Board never posts to Slack; CoS owns draft → approve → post.

decision.description: Board Chair ruling in plain language — the binding decision text to write back.

owners.description: People or roles accountable for executing the decision (e.g. CoS, Board eng lead, Alliance PM).

thisWeek.description: Exactly three concrete actions for the current week derived from the ruling.

sessionId.description: Id of the Board/Mastermind session that produced the ruling (traceability).

repoHints.description: Optional repo paths or org/name hints agents should touch when executing thisWeek (e.g. Board Expo app, mstrmnd-os).

source.description: Origin of the ruling: Board Chair session or Mastermind session.

status.description: Lifecycle: CoS starts draft; human/CoS marks approved; only then posted to Slack by CoS.

silentSendForbidden.description: Always true. Agents must not silently post; Board never posts to Slack — CoS does after approval.

examples.decision: Board Expo moves to New Architecture this week; EAS production profile gated behind TestFlight.
thisWeek: Install expo-upgrade + expo-dev-client skills and run New Arch checklist
Add eas-workflows PR preview build for Board
Draft TestFlight submit path via eas-app-stores (no silent Slack)
